classification.difficultyReason: Direct recognition or a familiar short procedure. The greatest member of this finite real set is 10.

content.prompt:
Let $A$ be a subset of $\mathbb R$. Define the following.
$$\begin{aligned}\max A&=x\in A\text{ where }x\ge a\text{ for any }a\in A\\\min A&=x\in A\text{ where }x\le a\text{ for any }a\in A\end{aligned}$$
Find $\max\{-2,7,10\}$.

answer.worked: $10$ belongs to the set and is at least every other element. Hence $\max\{-2,7,10\}=10$.
